title: On the Nonemptiness of the Core: Connecting Cooperative Games and Asset Pricing
abstract: arXiv:2611.13189v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We show that the Bondareva--Shapley theorem for infinite cooperative games can be derived from a version of the fundamental theorem of asset pricing. The link is the Choquet extension of a game, viewed as a possibly nonlinear pricing rule on the space of measurable simple payoffs. Under this identification, balancedness translates into no arbitrage, and a linear functional dominated by the pricing rule yields an allocation in the anti-core; the core statement follows by duality.   Applying the arbitrage-free pricing theorem of Cornet (2025), we recover the characterization of the nonvacuity of the core initiated by Schmeidler (1967) and established in full generality by Bartl and Pinter (2023) for bounded-below games. Unlike the earlier derivation in Cornet (2025), our argument does not require the game to have bounded variation or the collection of coalitions to be a $\sigma$-algebra.

translated_title: 论核心的非空性：连接合作博弈与资产定价
translated_abstract: 我们证明，无限合作博弈的Bondareva–Shapley定理可以从资产定价基本定理的一个版本推导出来。其联系的桥梁是博弈的Choquet扩张，它可被视为可测简单支付空间上的一个可能非线性的定价规则。在这种对应下，平衡性等价于无套利，而由该定价规则支配的线性泛函给出反核心中的一个配置；核心的结论则由对偶性得到。应用Cornet（2025）的无套利定价定理，我们重新获得了由Schmeidler（1967）开创、并由Bartl和Pinter（2023）在完全一般性下建立的有下界博弈核心非空性的刻画。与Cornet（2025）较早的推导不同，我们的论证既不要求博弈具有有界变差，也不要求联盟集合构成一个σ-代数。
tldr: 该论文的创举在于将博弈的Choquet扩张视为一种（可能非线性的）定价规则，从而从资产定价基本定理推出无限合作博弈的Bondareva–Shapley定理，使平衡性对应于无套利，并由此在无需有界变差和σ-代数假设的条件下重新得到核心非空性的刻画。
en_tdlr: The paper's key innovation is to view a game's Choquet extension as a (possibly nonlinear) pricing rule, thereby deriving the Bondareva–Shapley theorem for infinite cooperative games from the fundamental theorem of asset pricing, where balancedness corresponds to no arbitrage, and recovering core nonemptiness characterizations without requiring bounded variation or a σ-algebra of coalitions.
